initial_plan.answerability: partly: this dataset can compare annual pedestrian death counts in Brooklyn, but it cannot measure risk per walking trip, distance, or population exposure.
initial_plan.metric: Annual number of pedestrians killed, calculated as the sum of number_of_pedestrians_killed across crashes.
initial_plan.denominator: None; an absolute annual count, not a rate.
initial_plan.population: Police-reported motor vehicle crashes in Brooklyn, with pedestrians killed represented by the per-crash count.
filters: crash_date in calendar year 2013 or later
use complete calendar years only if data checks identify partial boundary years
initial_plan.years: Calendar years from 2013 through the latest year present; assess whether boundary years are partial before analysis.

data_check_meaning_and_decisions.population_and_coverage: The normalized Brooklyn filter finds 483,501 crashes dated 2013-01-01 through 2026-06-11. Each year 2013-2025 has observed dates spanning January 1 through December 31; 2026 ends on June 11 and is partial. Exclude the 9,700 crashes in 2026 rather than compare a partial-year count with full years.
data_check_meaning_and_decisions.filter_and_group_columns: Among rows matching the Brooklyn population and 2013+ date filter, borough and crash_date are not missing; there are no unknown/default borough labels, default 1900/1970 dates, or missing/impossible years. Match borough case-insensitively after trimming whitespace. Keep qualifying rows and disclose that unlabeled/non-Brooklyn records are outside this population.
data_check_meaning_and_decisions.summed_columns: No rows in the checked population have a missing pedestrian-death count. Keep all rows in complete years; no outcome rows need to be dropped or imputed.
data_check_meaning_and_decisions.plan_changes: Finalize the period as 2013-2025, excluding partial 2026, and make the Brooklyn text filter case/whitespace-insensitive.

final_plan.answerability: Partly: compares annual pedestrian death counts in Brooklyn, but does not measure risk per walking trip, distance, or population exposure.
final_plan.metric: Annual pedestrians killed = sum of number_of_pedestrians_killed across Brooklyn crashes.
final_plan.population: Police-reported crashes dated in complete calendar years 2013-2025 whose borough, after trimming whitespace and ignoring case, is Brooklyn; the outcome counts pedestrians killed, not crashes.
filters: retain all eligible rows because the summed column is not missing in the checked population
final_plan.years: 2013-2025 inclusive; exclude 2026 because observed coverage ends 2026-06-11.
final_plan.limitations: Absolute counts are not exposure-adjusted risk and can vary with walking activity, reporting, and other factors; the file contains partial 2026 data through June 11, excluded from the annual comparison. Borough labels are normalized for case and surrounding whitespace.
